text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vivlos asked me to check her dancing, so when I headed over to the dance studio—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —No more! What even is this?!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what's up, Sweep?
You seem kind of upset?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's this dance routine!
I only learned it because they said it was favored by witches, but..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It's all messy and weird, that's why!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's the thing that's buzzing on social media♡
I've never really taken a close look at it, though~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hmm. I see...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: When you're humming along♪

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Next, it's tap-tap-tap...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Next up, make it something a little cool~

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: And to wrap it up... yes, strike a cute pose♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what...!!
How are you able to do that?!
choice_data_list: Is there any trick to memorizing it?
Is there a trick to remembering it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"I've never really thought much about it, but...
Hmmm..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! See, see, it's just like magic!
Spells get named after what they do, right?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Just give names like 'Run-run' to this dance's moves too~,
and dance them in order!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ! Just like... magic...
choice_data_list: In other words, the trick is "magic"!
In other words, the trick is "magic"!
Vivlos sure is a good teacher, huh
Vivlos is such a good teacher, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ! Just like... magic...
choice_data_list: In other words, the trick is "magic"!
In other words, the trick is "magic"!
Vivlos sure is a good teacher, huh
Vivlos is such a good teacher, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That's right~♡
So, you can do it too, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Show me.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Dance one more time?
Ehh, then how about a reward or something—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Your magic, of course! You can use it, right?!
You know so much about magic, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Wait, that's what you're focusing on...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, I got praised♪
Praise Sweep too, praise meee♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! You did it faster than me,
the future Great Witch.
You should act a little prouder of yourself!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Huh? As if I'd do that!
Even if I did, it wouldn't make me happy~.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I can do my best
if you praise me and spoil me lots♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is that so... In that case...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: So, yeah! Praise me, praise me~♡

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
âI might just praise you!
That is, if you can dance better than me in a few days!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm Sweep Tosho!
The great witch of the future...
There's no way I'm staying a loser!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe!
Guess I'll go all out then♪
